source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The patch passes Span<const ImapUid> instead of a pointer/count pair into folder fetch batching. The loop still narrows Length to uint32_t and updates progress from the helper’s mutable count. Its do/while has no empty-span guard; the inspected changed callers check for nonempty arrays. This is a scoped source contract, not general size validation, ownership safety or an executed empty-batch result.
title: UID batch spans remove a separate count but keep narrowing and loop assumptions
